title: Sharing a live order demonstration

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: I can show the slides from the room computer, but the customer wants to see our order screen change while I talk. The example account only works on my laptop.
turns.zh: 我可以用現場電腦放投影片，但客戶想看到訂單畫面在我解說時即時變動。示範帳號只能在我的筆電上用。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Use the room computer for the slides and connect your laptop to the second screen. The second screen shows whatever is connected to it, but people joining remotely only see what the room computer shares.
turns.zh: 投影片還是用現場電腦放，你的筆電接到第二個螢幕。第二個螢幕會顯示接到它的裝置畫面，但遠端與會者只看得到現場電腦分享的畫面。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Then they would miss the order demonstration. What if I join the meeting from my laptop as well?
turns.zh: 那遠端的人就看不到訂單示範了。如果我也用筆電加入同一場會議呢？

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: You can share the laptop screen in the same meeting, but keep that laptop muted and turn off its microphone. Use the room computer for sound so we don’t hear an echo.
turns.zh: 你可以在同一場會議裡分享筆電的畫面，但請把筆電靜音，並關閉它的麥克風。聲音用現場電腦，以免出現回音。
